scope: B2-D ordinary epoch-local block-validation body, receipt, mandatory double-vote evidence, ordered-root, logical-size, and ordinary proposal binding kernel only

imports.note: B2-D imports the exact validator set, ordinary QC, and vote signing values needed by its next-view fixture. It imports no TC, never authorizes synthetic QCs, and does not widen any imported decoder.
Only BlockHeaderV0 encoding and BlockKindV0 values are imported. B2-D admits block_kind=regular only and imports no anchor or handoff authorization capability.
The independent B2-D gate recomputes all three root families and their frozen empty roots; it does not call the existing ordered-root checker.

The B2-D reference fixture binds its active parameter hash and byte cap to this committed preimage. The Node gate does not generalize that one fixture into complete parameter-provenance authorization.

hard_limits.count_preallocation_rule: Before any Vec/Array allocation, reject a declared count that cannot fit the remaining bytes at the object's minimum encoded item width or the trusted active ConsensusParametersV0 max_block_bytes.

reference_profile_limits.equality_rule: For this committed reference profile, a logical block or CEV0 List<Bytes> of derived receipts exactly 4194304 bytes is accepted; one byte more is rejected.
reference_profile_limits.non_normative_note: 4194304 is not an eternal B2-D protocol hard cap. A production decoder receives the authenticated active parameter limit; outer decoded/reassembled protobuf transport-body admission is a separate bound.

objects.verifier_contract: SignatureVerifier is public and unsealed. Production admission MUST supply trnm_consensus_crypto::StrictEd25519Verifier; the concrete strict path is exercised by this cryptographic corpus. A token produced with a permissive verifier proves only that verifier's acceptance.

honest_boundary: B2-D closes only exact ordinary body/receipt/double-vote encodings, independent raw-byte parsing, three ordered roots, logical block size, protobuf projection drift, real strict-Ed25519 double-vote fixtures, and one ordinary epoch-local next-view logical ProposalSignV0/projection binding fixture.

The empty ApplicationPayloadV0 encoding 00000000 is frozen and tested, including as the body used by a seal elsewhere, but this ordinary-only kernel does not authorize or validate any seal/checkpoint/handoff block.

Receipt bytes and receipts_root are intended to be locally derived execution commitments. This kernel accepts typed caller-supplied commitments and proves no runtime provenance; B2-D creates no peer receipt transport authority and freezes no runtime execution outcome/status predicate.
Double-vote cryptography is reproducible and verified, but active-set provenance and economic/slashing authorization remain external authenticated inputs.

The proposal fixture accepts only a regular next-view block, one ordinary QC, absent TC/digest, absent epoch-anchor authorization, and absent handoff digest. It is not a protobuf Proposal decoder and does not close protobuf presence/default admission, skipped-view TC, genesis-first, first-new-epoch, anchor, handoff, checkpoint, or synthetic-QC paths.

ValidatedBlockCommitmentsV0 is a private-field typed result with no raw decoder. It proves only Regular kind, evidence shape/order and acceptance by the supplied SignatureVerifier, caller-supplied receipt-to-payload relations, the three roots, and logical/receipt sizes. Because SignatureVerifier is public/unsealed, the token does not attest verifier identity or intrinsically prove strict Ed25519; production MUST use trnm_consensus_crypto::StrictEd25519Verifier, whose concrete path is exercised by the crypto corpus. A permissive verifier can produce a token that proves only permissive acceptance. Public receipt constructors mean the token does not prove execution or authorized-runtime provenance; protocol integration must supply receipts from the locally authorized deterministic runtime. It does not authenticate parent state or authorize a vote.

Authenticated parent state, runtime/set/parameter provenance, complete Proposal/Block host integration, terminal journals, checkpoint sync, epoch transition, transport admission, light client, B2 overall, and wire_conformance remain open.
